milestone: 0.5.0 development: floating transport balance and Layout theme proportions

reference.inspection: Both local captures inspected. Source ownership: MainWindowController builds floating transport in the center with separate leading volume/trailing toolbar; SidebarLayoutPane uses an AppKit NSSegmentedControl for Theme. Independent Slint layouts, no artwork/source copied.
reference.scale_limit: Supplied capture scale is unrecorded; inferred point conversions do not establish pixel acceptance.

baseline.headless: Fifteen prior widget regressions pass; three new tests fail on the unchanged UI.
observations: Theme segments measure 30 high inside a 24 high rail; they require 20 high with two point insets.
With the toolbar empty, floating Play frame center is x558 instead of x500 in a 1000-wide player. With the default four actions the unequal reservations produce about 10 points of drift.
The 285-wide controller does not center Play even though symmetric reservations for its four actions and single transport button can fit.

implementation: Keep 30-point Playlist/Chapters tabs; constrain only Dark/Light/Auto segments to 20 points inside their 24-point rail and expose selected accessibility state.
Reserve equal sides around transport, retain the volume placeholder without an audio track, and align the actual toolbar to the trailing edge.
Use the actual transport width and both row insets/gaps for the fit threshold. Center the compact row where symmetric spaces fit; retain the existing packed adaptation below that limit.
Play/pause glyph assets remain unchanged; frame alignment and optical glyph balance are distinct checks.
Center the Floating/Top/Bottom group and each preview on the scroll page; retain 66 x 74 frames and eight point gaps even in narrow scrollable panes.
Center symbols, labels and switches on their Layout row; center section rules on their captions. Compact Interface, Theme and sidebar-position rows share this alignment.
Bind the Layout page width to the explicit scroll extent, preventing the visible Flickable width from squeezing the page; keep its inferred minimum independent to avoid a binding cycle.
Make section titles span the page so their centered rules have visible width.

checks.build: Locked workspace build passed on Windows 11 x64.
checks.workspace: 626 passed, 56 ignored; two test threads. Native integration tests remain separately gated by the pinned DLL.

new_scope: Theme selection and equal 20-point segment bounds across palette/spacing changes and normal/narrow widths. Narrow activation uses the accessibility action; pointer activation is checked at normal width.
Floating Play/Pause frame center independent of empty/single/default/five-action toolbars, audio presence, compact spacing and either sidebar side.
Disjoint default actions at 200/285/340/360/380/400/440 widths; centered transport where symmetric spaces fit.
Centered 66 x 74 controller choices, eight-point gaps and centered previews at 285/320/960 widths in both spacing modes.
Layout symbol/switch/caption centerlines; section rules share caption centerlines and have visible width.

checks.inventories: Settings navigation and parity/reference checks passed; inventory remains incomplete.

smoke.capture: Before/fullscreen/after at 3840 x 2160; non-black probes passed, all full images inspected. Native video and controller remain visible together, with no residual surface after normal exit.

manual_gui.fixture: Isolated moving-square.avi, paused at frame 000; null audio, looping, no neighboring fixtures.
results: Floating transport frame visibly centered with the default four actions; no audio/volume layout changed during this check.

Light Layout inspected with Compact Interface on and off. Compact Interface, Theme, material mini-row and video-setting symbols align with their labels/switches. Controller choices/previews are centered, with visible centered section rules.
Dark and Auto selected by pointer; selection stays in the rail. Auto settles to this desktop light appearance.
Normal Size native command yields 285 x 160 controls (287 x 228 outer with wrapped menu). Two attempted border drags did not resize the test window; these are not reported as passing resize gestures.
Vertical scrolling reveals normal-sized controller previews and labels. Horizontal scrolling reaches both the leading Floating tile and trailing Bottom tile without squeezing the page.
Close sidebar restores the centered single transport button with all four disjoint actions. Space resumes visible frames 006/008; Pause retains the same center.
manual_gui.shutdown: Normal Alt+F4; no Riina process before the smoke and after it.

remaining_gaps: Materials, exact glyph silhouettes, other DPI and matched macOS states need additional comparison.
Extreme narrow layouts retain a packed transport/action row. Docked controller placement and Music Mode require their own reference comparison.
private_evidence: Profiles and raw desktop captures remain under ignored target; no unrelated desktop content is published.

observations: Floating Play frame visibly centered with the default toolbar.
Dark, Light and Auto selections stayed within the theme rail; Auto followed this desktop light appearance.
Layout comparison revealed left-aligned choice group/previews and top-aligned Compact Interface/other symbols; a follow-up corrects these.
native_first_candidate.shutdown: Normal Alt+F4; zero Riina processes before follow-up build.

follow_up_diagnosis: The first centered-tile regression failed at narrow widths: ScrollView children inherit the visible Flickable width, not its content extent. The explicit page-width binding and independent minimum repair that boundary.

native_intermediate_candidate.scope: Compact icon/choice alignment and pointer Dark selection inspected. Tab from Dark focuses Light within its rail; Space selects Light without resuming the paused fixture, and the light palette settles correctly. This precedes the final scroll-extent/section-rule-width correction.
native_intermediate_candidate.shutdown: Normal Alt+F4; zero Riina processes before final build.
